title: Subperiosteal Tunneling Technique for Horizontal Maxillary Ridge Augmentation Utilizing Sticky Bone. Al shammari, Z
authors: Abdel-Rahman, F., Elgohary, N., Ahmed, N. (2026). Egyptian Dental Journal, 72(2), pp. 1203-1210. doi: 10.21608/edj.2026.454747.3735
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone plus (bovine bone with hyaluronate) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Both biomaterial com posites were effective in preserving graft volume. The subperiosteal tunneling technique proved to be a predictable method for achieving adequate horizontal ridge width intended for future implant placement, with minimal pain and excellent healing” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
